sources: https://fallcreekmarinaandcampground.com/ (read 2026-11-24): 'Our RV campground is the perfect place for family getaways. Each site is metered for electricity and has 30-50 amp service and is a short walk from the marina and restaurant. Camping is for vacation only and not open to full time living.' Rates under the heading 'Annual': '$340 (per month) Lake Front', '$310 (per month) Interior', 'Contact us'. No nightly, weekly or transient rate and no booking engine anywhere on the site (single page: campground, marina, store, restaurant).

Google Maps listing 'Fall Creek Marina And Campground', 5656 Fall Creek Dock Rd, Russellville, TN 37860, +1 423-581-4701 (headless browser, read 2026-11-24): 4.5 stars, 197 reviews (the listing covers the marina, store and restaurant as well as the campground)

Esri World Imagery (read 2026-11-24, late-autumn frame at winter drawdown): every pad on the marina peninsula holds a parked trailer; perimeter pads on the peninsula's west and north-west tip (~36.2880,-83.2238 and ~36.2884,-83.2236) and the south row (~36.2876,-83.2228) sit ~10-30 m from the grass/high-water edge over open ground
summary: Operator site posts only 'Annual' rates by the month ($340 lakefront, $310 interior) and no nightly rate or booking: drop candidate on long-stay test 2. Lakefront confirmed for the peninsula perimeter pads. Phone and website unchanged. Google 4.5/197 (shared with marina/restaurant).
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (long-stay test 2): the operator's only campground prices are 'Annual' monthly rates - '$340 (per month) Lake Front', '$310 (per month) Interior' - with 'Contact us' and no nightly rate, booking engine or transient wording; 'Camping is for vacation only and not open to full time living.' Imagery shows every peninsula pad holding a parked trailer at winter drawdown. Same pattern as the KY Cedars RV Park drop (monthly/seasonal-only rates). RV Life's $$ tier rests on one undated review (avg_rate 35) and does not stand in for test 2. Google 4.5 / 197 reviews, but the listing is the marina, store and restaurant as a whole.

WATERFRONT: lakefront holds if kept - the peninsula's perimeter pads (west/north-west tip ~36.2880,-83.2238 and ~36.2884,-83.2236; south row ~36.2876,-83.2228) are ~10-30 m from Cherokee Lake's high-water (grass) edge over open, mown ground on Esri imagery; the operator sells a 'Lake Front' site class. Interior pads east of the lot are not.
PHONE 423-581-4701 and website fallcreekmarinaandcampground.com confirmed (Google listing and operator site). Pin 36.2879,-83.2227 is on the campground at the marina lot; fine.

NEIGHBOURS: the large packed park on the shore south-east of the marina on the imagery is not this entry's peninsula; 'Greenlee of Fall Creek' (RV Life 7090, 125 sites, 36.2943,-83.2333, ~1.2 km NW) is a separate park. Only the marina peninsula's pads were judged.
